arStrings.szText:
Casting any Skill grants {c_number}{}{/c} stack of {c_important}Enlightenment{/c}, or grants {c_number}{}{/c} if your previous cast Skill was a different Element.

After gaining {c_number}{}{/c} stacks you become {c_important}Enlightened{/c}, can no longer gain stacks, and lose {c_number}{0}{/c} stacks per second.

While {c_important}Enlightened{/c} your Damage Bonuses with Fire, Lightning, and Cold are equal to the highest among them and you gain:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[{}*100|%x|]{/c} Damage
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[{}*100|%+|]{/c} Mana Regeneration
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[{}*100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed
